violation_type.title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Routines Maintained (26 TAC §746.2501(1))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Routines Maintained
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated during the investigation and was found to be deficient. Caregivers did not ensure that a toddler's diaper was routinely changed during the day.

finding_variants.text: This standard was evaluated during the investigation and was found to be deficient. Caregivers did not ensure that a toddler's diaper was routinely changed during the day.
No routine observed while in opertation, Toddler room was in the afterschool room and activity plan was not being followed.
Based on the interviews, diaper-changing procedures were not being maintained closely when a child was observed several times with a soiled pull-up.
It was determined that staff failed to maintain regular diapering routines, resulting in a child going the entire day without a diaper change.

Children were observed not following a routine. Children were running around the room, playing in different activities, aside from what the caregiver was covering.  Food was observed to be served approximately one hour after the time listed on the schedule.

This standard was evaluated during the investigation and was found to be deficient. A diaper changing routine was not maintained resulting in a child wearing the same diaper from morning drop off to late afternoon pick up. The child's diaper was wet as the child was picked up during the end of nap time.
